narratives.None: Against a relatively light mixed SRBM/drone salvo, you were able to destroy all incoming threats primarily via your higher-end air defense systems.
narratives.Mild: Your air defenses performed well, but some {SRBMs and drones} leaked through. The impacts were on the periphery of the base and air operations were not significantly impacted.
narratives.Moderate: With limited air defense systems engaging incoming threats, MSAB sustained significant damage to runways, requiring at least 24hrs for ground crews to clear explosives, debris, and repair the craters caused by cluster munitions.
narratives.Severe: With {limited, no} air defense systems available to target incoming threats, MSAB sustained major damage from incoming Iranian drones and missiles. Runways suffered significant damage that will take ground crews upwards of 24hrs to repair. A fuel storage facility on the ground was severely damaged, causing a large fire. Additionally, a drone hit a U.S. F-15EX parked in the open.

narratives.None: At the cost of many of your available higher-end interceptors, you were able to destroy all incoming threats and prevent any damage on the ground.
narratives.Mild: Blue defenses intercepted most, but not all of the incoming threats. Most of the weapons seemed to miss their target and fell in unoccupied parts of the base. Air operations were halted for a few hours while damage was assessed and ground crews made minor repairs.
narratives.Moderate: Because there were few ballistic and cruise missile interceptors remaining, much of the salvo hit the base, causing significant damage to runways and destroying a Patriot radar. Air operations will be halted for at least 24hrs while ground crews perform repairs. Given its degraded air defenses, the base is vulnerable to follow on attacks.
narratives.Severe: With almost no air defense systems available to stop incoming threats, PSAB sustained major damage. Widespread craters across both runways have fully halted any air operations for at least 48hrs, while many weapons targeted air defenses destroying both two Patriot radars. The base is incredibly vulnerable to follow on strikes.

narratives.None: Using available higher-end interceptors, you were able to destroy all incoming threats and prevent any damage on the ground.
narratives.Mild: Blue's sophisticated ballistic and air defenses shot down almost all of the incoming missiles. Most of these missiles failed to strike their presumed targets, though some incidental damage was done to a residential building on base.
narratives.Moderate: While Blue was able to destroy a portion of the incoming missiles using its high-end interceptors, a significant fraction leaked, causing widespread, but minor, damage to the naval base. Access to several command buildings has been temporarily restricted while damage is assessed and minor repairs are executed. Port operations and Fifth fleet command functions continue, though at a reduced tempo while the base works through the disruption.
narratives.Severe: With limited interceptors available, {almost all, all} of the incoming missiles penetrated Blue's air defenses. They caused widespread damage on the ground, including indefinite closure of several command buildings, damage to power distribution causing a temporary blackout to some buildings, damage to fuel storage, igniting fires, and several casualties. Command for operations in the region has temporarily been moved off base while repairs are made.

narratives.None: Using high-end interceptors, you were able to destroy all incoming threats and prevent any damage on the ground.
narratives.Mild: Blue's higher-end interceptors available to intercepted incoming threats but could not destroy all of them. Most weapons fell in unoccupied parts of the base. Air operations were halted for a few hours while damage was assessed and ground crews made minor repairs.
narratives.Moderate: With limited availability of interceptors, many of the incoming threats leaked through, causing significant damage to runways and destroying a Patriot radar. Air operations will be halted for at least 24hrs while ground crews perform repairs. Given the ongoing conflict, a replacement radar is not immediately available, so the base is vulnerable to follow on attacks.
narratives.Severe: With almost no air defense systems available to stop incoming threats, Isa AB sustained major damage. Widespread craters across Isa's runway have fully halted any air operations indefinitely, while a large salvo {ballistic missile, Shahed-136s} targeted known air defense emplacements destroyed both a Patriot radar and its associated launchers. Bahrani officials report damage to several F-16s stationed at the base.

narratives.None: Despite the size of the incoming salvo, you were able to destroy {all, almost all} incoming threats and prevent any damage on the ground, though at the cost of many of your higher-end interceptors.
narratives.Mild: Blue had interceptors available to tackle incoming threats but could not destroy all of them. The primary control tower suffered minor damage and air operations were temporarily halted while damage was assessed and repaired. Support personnel exposed during the attack suffered minor injuries but no casualties have been reported.
narratives.Moderate: While Blue was able to destroy a portion of the incoming missiles using its high-end interceptors, a significant fraction leaked. These threats were centered on both air operations support infrastructure and personnel housing, causing significant damage to operating surfaces, destruction of a repair depot, and several casualties. Air operations will be halted for at least 24 hours while damage is assessed and repaired.
narratives.Severe: With almost no air defense systems available to stop incoming threats, Al Udeid sustained major damage. Widespread craters across runways have fully halted any air operations for at least 48hrs, while the main control tower has been indefinitely closed amid major structural damage. Devastation of a building housing primarily support personnel has caused several deaths and debilitating injuries, placing strain on available staff to support further air operations.
